_meta.batch: Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thief (108 terminow) - druga i ostatnia czesc mechaniki dedukcji Grimoire/Sally (po batch_48 'A Murderer...'), rekonstruujaca jak sprawca (Godrik, patrz batch_44-47) dostal sie do zamknietej Kajuty Kapitana i ukradl Jezyk Syreny z Kotla: przechylil lodz podwodna (recznie kolowrotem liny w Teatrze Iluzji, bez widocznosci co robi), zeby kluczyk w ksztalcie oka sturlal sie do kratki wentylacyjnej zezy, wszedl przez dziure w podlodze Kajuty Kapitana (pod biurkiem/dywanem) po linie Dzwonu.
_meta.speaker_resolution: speaker_map.json (soulTalking) - 68/108 pokryte. Nieprzypisane (40): Request (15) + 4 Choice sety (ds47/ds50/ds64/ds78, po 4 kazdy plus Question) - standardowe 'Grimoire (domniemany)'/'Grimoire (opcja wyboru)'/'(naglowek wyboru)'.

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: And he shut it [i]tight[/i] - probably as tight as he could - and by all accounts, he was pretty strong...

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: He had a key, he would've locked it!
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.pl: Miał klucz, na pewno by je zamknął!
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: Definitely - since he'd've rearranged it like [i]we[/i] just did - moving the desk and the rug to reveal the hole...

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: [i]Mortuga's blood[/i] - it pooled out first, but then started running down towards the bilge vent...
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.pl: [i]Krew Mortugi[/i] - najpierw się rozlała, ale potem zaczęła spływać w stronę kratki zęzowej...
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: It steadily goes down... but then later, it suddenly goes back [i]up[/i] again!
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.pl: Stopniowo opada... ale potem nagle znowu idzie [i]w górę![/i]
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: So the moon vial rolled right off Mortuga's desk and through the hole in the floor...
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.pl: Więc fiolka moon stoczyła się z biurka Mortugi prosto przez dziurę w podłodze...
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: Once the culprit had the key, they could let themselves into the Captain's Cabin...
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.pl: Kiedy sprawca miał już kluczyk, mógł wejść do Kajuty Kapitana...
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: They climbed down the rope, through the hole...
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.pl: Zszedł po linie, przez dziurę...
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: Although, to get out - they'd need to climb back [i]up[/i] the bell rope.
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.pl: Chociaż, żeby się wydostać - musiałby wspiąć się z powrotem [i]po[/i] linie dzwonu.
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: ...and into this room - where they were free to take the contents of the cauldron for themselves.
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.pl: ...i do tego pomieszczenia - gdzie mógł swobodnie zabrać zawartość kotła dla siebie.
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: ...and after that, all they had to do was cover the hole back up with the rug and the desk.
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.pl: ...a potem musiał tylko z powrotem zakryć dziurę dywanem i biurkiem.
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: Anything else?
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.pl: Coś jeszcze?
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: A phenomenon observed at the crime scene...
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.pl: Zjawisko zaobserwowane na miejscu zbrodni...
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: A clue found in the control room...
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.pl: Trop znaleziony w sterowni...
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: A clue found at the crime scene...
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.pl: Trop znaleziony na miejscu zbrodni...
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.speaker: Grimoire (opcja wyboru)

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: Evidence that the submarine was surfaced shortly after the murder.
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.pl: Dowód na to, że łódź podwodna wynurzyła się wkrótce po morderstwie.
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.speaker: (naglowek wyboru)

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: The cauldron was [i]always[/i] empty.
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.pl: Kocioł [i]zawsze[/i] był pusty.
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: The culprit didn't [i]need[/i] to use that door.
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.pl: Sprawca nie [i]musiał[/i] używać tych drzwi.
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: How?
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.pl: Jak?
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: But then he died - in a [i]locked[/i] room. So how did someone [i]else[/i] get hold of it?
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.pl: Ale wtedy zginął - w [i]zamkniętym[/i] pomieszczeniu. Więc jak ktoś [i]inny[/i] mógł się tym zawładnąć?
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: -it fell into the bilge?
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.pl: -wpadł do zęzy?
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.speaker: Sally

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: The culprit used a magnet.
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.pl: Sprawca użył magnesu.
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.speaker: Grimoire

Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.en: So the eyeball key just [i]happened[/i] to roll across the floor and into the vent?
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.pl: Więc kluczyk w kształcie oka po prostu [i]przypadkiem[/i] potoczył się po podłodze i wpadł do kratki?
Conversation/Sally Topic 12 ...and a Thi.speaker: Sally
